# OpenSSL traditional private-key fixtures

These disposable test keys were generated by OpenSSL 4.0.3. They are public
test material. Never use them outside tests.

- EC: `openssl ecparam -name <curve> -genkey -noout -outform DER`, for
  `prime256v1`, `secp384r1`, and `secp521r1`.
- DSA: `openssl dsaparam 1024`, then `openssl gendsa` on those parameters
  and `openssl dsa -outform DER` on the resulting key.
- Reference PKCS#8: `openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -nocrypt -inform DER -outform DER`
  for each traditional DER key.
